nav.$description: SHADOWS The shadow scale (xs…2xl) and its aliases live in the EFFECTS block below — this section keeps only the nav shadow, which is referenced by §2.1 and has no equivalent step on that scale. The two Framer-era values that used to sit here (`--shadow`, `--shadow-lg`) were redefined further down anyway, so they never applied. Nav bar shadow (§2.1 — present on every nav variant)

_.$description: Legacy shadow alias. `--shadow-lg: var(--shadow-md)` and a repeat of `--shadow-nav` used to follow this line; both were later definitions of tokens already set above, and the --shadow-lg one silently collapsed the scale's lg step onto md for every consumer. Removed 2026-09-23 — only --shadow stays, since the scale has no plain `--shadow` step.

0.$description: EFFECTS — opacity / blur / shadow / glass / noise / gradient (Wugweb Kits token architecture; see kits_design_system/docs/tokens/) Opacity scale — never hardcode opacity

soft.$description: De-emphasis pair. Both were referenced across the site (and documented in src/components/README.md as `--opacity-soft: .7`) but never defined, so every `opacity: var(--opacity-soft)` was invalid at computed-value time and silently rendered at full opacity. Used by: TrustBadges, SiteHeader menu icon, about tile copy, homepage client logos, blog "last updated", blog index, work-grid placeholder initials.

muted.$description: Same failure mode as the pair above. `--opacity-muted` (de-emphasised label) and `--opacity-subtle` (resting state of a control that brightens on hover/active) were referenced on /services but never defined, so the panel index numbers and the inactive tier tabs rendered at full opacity. Ordered against the interaction ramp: subtle .60 → hover .90 → active 1.
